question: The 'Stree Manoraksha' Project launched in Bengaluru by the Government of India in March 2022 aims at improving ________ health of women in India.
solution:
The correct answer is **__mental__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Ministry of Women and Child Development (MoWCD)** and **NIMHANS Bengaluru launched a Project**’ in March 2022 **with the goal of improving women’s mental health in India.**
 
• The increasing ability of OSC (One-Stop Center) officials in terms of tools and procedures for One-Stop Centers, particularly those who have experienced violence and distress, with compassion and care.
 
• One-Stop Center performed admirably during the COVID time.
 
• There are already over **700 One-Stop Centers operating across the country. **
 
• People who work in these one-stop shops will be taught how to appropriately operate the **Self Defense Shaheed Women helpline and counsel.**
 
• The advanced training programme will be delivered in all of the regional languages that they want to be able to com website dedicated to this, which contains a wealth of information on training.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ministry of Women and Child Development:

 
 
• ​The Department of Women and Child Development was set up in the year **1985 **as a part of the Ministry of Human Resource Development to give the much-needed impetus to the holistic development of women and children.
 
• With **effect from 30 January 2006**, the Department has been upgraded to a Ministry.
 
• The Ministry of Women and Child Development, a branch of the Government of India, is an apex body for** the formulation and administration of the rules and regulations and laws relating to women and child development in India.**
 
• The current minister for the Ministry of Women and Child Development is** Smriti Irani having held the portfolio since 31 May 2019.**
